title: Scenario coverage evaluation
responsibility: Judges declared scenario coverage against a selected record and recorded change impact.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.detail
inputs.description: Revision with record-specific comparison and first-parent source impact.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.record
inputs.description: Record whose applicable impact should be inspected.

inputs.name: coverageAffected.unit
inputs.description: Unit identifier to look for in direct, indirect or added impact.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.detail
inputs.description: Revision supplying registry units and comparison evidence.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.record
inputs.description: Selected record, or null for absent evidence. Current tests and inherited origin-test summaries may include browser diagnostics.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.unit
inputs.description: Unit whose applicable scenario states should be judged.

inputs.name: explorerCoverage.absent
inputs.description: Optional absent-record standing and reason, defaulting to missing with no verification record attached.

outputs.name: coverageAffected
outputs.description: True when applicable impact includes the unit, false when that impact exists and excludes it, or null when no applicable impact is recorded. Prefers comparison for this record, otherwise source impact with the record’s base.

outputs.name: explorerCoverage
outputs.description: Returns a scenario-evaluation function. It narrows states to the unit, checks declarations, test outcomes, result lineage and required captures, then returns tests, state details, inheritance and worst standing. Inherited results require a bound origin and recorded proof that the unit was unaffected; missing origin test evidence stays incomplete. Each listed check retains optional diagnostics from the record where it ran: the current record for fresh results and the origin-test summary for inherited results. Diagnostics are carried for display; this helper judges check outcomes from their recorded status.
